# Vendored from Oracle

This directory contains Oracle's upstream agent skill, vendored so it is
available to all shared CLI agents (Claude Code, omp, Codex, and Amp).

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/steipete/oracle
- **Tag:** `v0.21.2`
- **Pinned commit:** `12596c9f6518e99cf850e698614f9d8cef4e7860`
- **License:** MIT — see the upstream repository
- **Source path:** `skills/oracle/SKILL.md`

The `SKILL.md` file is a condensed adaptation of the pinned Oracle release;
model-specific compatibility guidance remains in the upstream skill. When
bumping Oracle, refresh this file from the newly pinned release and review it.
